_note: gCO2 per passenger-km. The car factor is fleet-weighted from the REAL Singapore car fuel mix (LTA Annual Vehicle Statistics 2025), not a flat guess. MRT/electric modes scale with the EMA grid factor.

_sources.car: Fleet-weighted from LTA Annual Vehicle Statistics 2025 (ICE 74.2%, hybrid 18.4%, BEV 7.4%): 0.742*165 + 0.184*95 + 0.074*50 = 144 gCO2/pkm. Per-type from DEFRA 2024 + EMA grid factor for BEV.
_sources.bus: DEFRA 2024 local bus, occupancy-adjusted for SG high-load network (~70 gCO2/pkm)
_sources.mrt: Derived: ~0.06 kWh/pkm (LTA energy intensity) x EMA grid factor 0.402

car_fleet_2025.source: LTA Annual Vehicle Statistics 2025 (MVP by fuel type)
